title: Consolidate embed iterator leasing and HTTP error harmonization
creator: Mariana Ortiz
description: Summary: There is a long-standing divergence between the embeddings and rerank endpoints in how pagination/iteration tokens, transient errors, and HTTP status codes are surfaced to clients. This ticket defines a convergent approach: 1) introduce a lightweight iterator-lease token that encodes window state and tombstone semantics, 2) normalize HTTP error mappings across the vector/emb-rerank surface, and 3) provide a compatibility adapter path for legacy clients while allowing new clients to opt-in to the improved contract. Goal is parity across SDKs and consistent retry semantics for customers migrating between hosted and dedicated/private deployments.
background:
Observed problems:
- Clients report ambiguous 500/502/503 vs 429 behavior when fetching paged embeddings + rerank results; retry guidance is inconsistent across docs and SDKs.
- Different iterator token formats between embed and rerank cause brittle client-side logic and double conversions.
- Streaming + iterator handoffs introduce subtle duplication when a page is reissued during transient restarts.
- Existing compat adapters mostly normalize cursor shape but not time-limited lease semantics or tombstone signals used for rollback behavior.
Why it matters:
- High-volume customers using vector search + reranking observe client-side timeouts and increased retry storms.
- Inconsistent retry semantics cause ordering/duplication bugs in pipelines and higher costs due to redundant requests.
proposal:
Design proposal highlights:
1) Iterator Lease Token: opaque base64 token with: iterator_id, window_start_index, lease_expiry (unix ms), version tag, optional tombstone flag. Lease semantics: server grants a lease when issuing a token; clients may renew within 50% of lease window. If lease expired, server responds with 410 Gone + standardized tombstone code.
2) Error normalization: canonicalize transient and permanent statuses across endpoints: 429 -> RateLimit (include Retry-After header), 503 -> ServiceUnavailable (retry with backoff), 500/502 -> ServerError (non-idempotent requests receive guidance), 410 -> IteratorExpired/Tombstoned. Attach consistent machine-readable error code in JSON body (e.g., error.code = \"iterator.expired\").
3) Backcompat adapter: API gateway to translate legacy cursor tokens to lease tokens when possible, or to return a migration hint header: X-Embed-Compat: migrate-needed. Gateway will also normalize HTTP statuses for legacy clients behind feature flag.
4) SDK changes: add lease-aware iterator helper that transparently renews leases and exposes tombstone events. Provide opt-in flag in SDK to enable strict mode (errors raised on any lease expiry) or permissive mode (best-effort resume).
5) Observability: emit events for lease_granted, lease_renewed, lease_expired, iterator_tombstone, and mapping decisions. Expose metrics for lease_renewal_rate and iterator_conflicts.
acceptance_criteria: API contract doc updated and reviewed by API guild
Gateway accepts legacy cursors and emits X-Embed-Compat when translation is lossy
Embeddings and Rerank endpoints return unified error.code fields for shared classes
SDK iterator helper published (js + python) with unit + integration tests
E2E smoke tests demonstrating no duplicate items on lease renew and correct tombstone handling
Observability: lease_* events emitted to telemetry and shown in Console traces

comments: 2026-02-22 | Alicia Chen: Scoped initial token shape with runtime. We agreed to keep the token opaque but sign it so gateway/runtime can validate without DB lookups. Runtime asked to include version tag for rolling upgrades.

2026-02-25 | Samir Patel (Infra): Flagging that lease renewals might increase load; propose exponential backoff with jitter and a central renewal rate limiter per customer. Also recommended tracking renewal_count in token to detect abusive loops.
2026-03-01 | Product Review (Mariana): UX note — expose tombstone reason codes in Console so customers can understand when a dataset was compacted vs iterator explicitly invalidated.
2026-03-05 | Design (Evelyn Park): Added wireframes for SDK iterator helper error surfaces; recommend two modes (strict / permissive) and a migration guide modal in Console.
2026-03-10 | Security (Jon Reed): Initial review done; recommend KMS signing for tokens in Private deployments and auditing for lease_renew events. Marked security_review_required=true.

2026-03-14 | Engineering (Alicia Chen): Prototype implemented behind feature flag in staging; observed 0.8% increased renewal calls, added per-customer rate limiter and queued executor for renewals; moving to integration testing.
next_steps: Finalize API doc and open the RFC in api-specs repo
Schedule gateway feature flag rollout in staging and run compatibility test suite
Push SDK iterator helper alpha to npm/pypi for early partner testing

notes: This approach favors predictable semantics for production workloads (explicit lease and tombstone) over the previous ad-hoc cursor approach. We will monitor cost impact and renewal amplification; if metrics exceed threshold we'll iterate on a passive cache-first strategy.
